== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Rebel Commander (Japanese)|Rebel Commander]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/tcg/company-sets/1997-decipher-star-wars-ccg-new-hope-limited-japanese/imagegallery/587873 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/164793244/YhUe4hZXfE65XBtvkA5s8g.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 164793244.

Crop rectangle <code>(262, 1118, 2331, 4003)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>f883c43a5b6fadfefd48bb7522acf53c24a8d9bf13887abdd88bd86859f3e87d</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
